title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession

funding_references.funder_name: National Nature and Science Foundation of China

description: This dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 25 Parkinson's disease patients enrolled in a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial of Neuroepo, a novel erythropoietin formulation. EEG data were acquired before and six months after drug administration, with both qualitative and quantitative source-level analyses performed to assess neuroprotective effects and identify neural biomarkers of disease progression.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded before and six months after administration of either Neuroepo (n=15) or placebo (n=10). Qualitative EEG analysis was performed by two experts using a Likert-type scale and multivariate item response theory (MIRT). Quantitative EEG analysis was conducted at the source level using VARETA software with co-registration to the Montreal Neurological Institute Atlas. Statistical comparisons between groups and timepoints were performed using permutation tests and contrast methods with Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons.
